Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionRevive the moto racing sipirit with this game, developed in 1994. Compete against motorcycles of 250cc, 550cc, and 750cc in different tracks full of obstacles and the best riders. Skills aren't going to be enough to win. Throughout the race you will find items that will give you power ups to help you beat your opponents. Use them to your advantage! Compete against a friend in 2 player mode (split screen) and discover once and for all who is the best Moto X racer.
